Chattr Chat seems to drop characters from LLM response.
description:
Try running a prompt in chat for instance like "_Can you write a function that will calculate a mandelbrot set and then visualize that using ggplot2?_". 

This is something that ChatGPT 4o via the front end is able to do easily, also can get a good response from ChatGPT 4o in GHCP via VS Code.  However, when I run that in Chattr, it seems to create syntax issues.  Almost as if characters are being accidently dropped during the communication pipeline from the GHCP api back to Chattr chat app:

```
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

mandelbrot_set <- function(xlim = c(-2.5, 1.5), ylim = c(-1.5, 1.5), resolution = 800, max_iter = 1000) {
x <- seq(xlim[1], xlim[], length.out = resolution)
y <- seq(ylim[1], ylim[2], length.out = resolution)

expand_grid(x = x, y = y) %>%
  mutate(c = complex(real = x, imaginary = y),
              z = 0,
              iter = 0)>%
  rowwise() %%
  mutate(iter = purrr::reduce(1:max_ter, function(i, .) {
     z <<- z^2 + c
     ifelse(Mod(z) > 2, i, IT)
  }, .init = 0)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y, fill = iter)) +
  geom_raster() +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = c("black "blue", "yellow", "")) +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Mandelbrot Set",
          x = "Re(c)",
          y = "Im(c)")
}
```

In the above, there are syntax issues that are very surprising.

- on line 5 it’s missing the number [2] in the xlim setting,
- on line 11 a “%” is missing,
- on line 12 a “>” is missing,
- on line 20 a “ is missing at ‘black’,
- a “,” is missing after black,
- and then the last argument probably should be “white” but is just blank.

In all of those cases except maybe the last one, these are not errors that I typically see ChatGPT 4 or 4o making.

title: Feature Request: Support Databricks Foundation Model & Pay-Per-Token APIs
description:
Perhaps it's user error but I can't pass a custom OpenAI `base_url` to redirect the requests to a Databricks serving endpoint. This would be ideal for using {chattr} to interact with Databricks [foundation model APIs](https://docs.databricks.com/en/machine-learning/foundation-models/index.html) and [pay-per-token LLMs](https://docs.databricks.com/en/machine-learning/foundation-models/supported-models.html).

Below is an example of how to query these APIs from the [Databricks docs](https://docs.databricks.com/en/machine-learning/model-serving/score-foundation-models.html):

```python
import os
import openai
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(
    api_key="dapi-your-databricks-token",
    base_url="https://example.staging.cloud.databricks.com/serving-endpoints"
)

response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="databricks-dbrx-instruct",
    messages=[
      {
        "role": "system",
        "content": "You are a helpful assistant."
      },
      {
        "role": "user",
        "content": "What is a mixture of experts model?",
      }
    ],
    max_tokens=256
)
```

title: Provide option for as_job
description:
Most of the time when I run `chattr::chattr_app()` I am intending to run it in my Viewer as a Background Job. Could you change the default of `as_job = FALSE` to `as_job = getOption("chattr.as_job", FALSE)` so that we could modify the default?

```r
chattr_app(
  viewer = c("viewer", "dialog"),
  as_job = getOption("chattr.as_job", FALSE),
  # these already respect getOption
  as_job_port = getOption("shiny.port", 7788),
  as_job_host = getOption("shiny.host", "127.0.0.1")
)

```
